targets.scope_note: conditional on international finance and support
targets.instrument_name: South Sudan's Second Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC2, 2021)
targets.source: UNFCCC NDC Registry - South Sudan Second NDC, sectoral emission reduction pathway table (Electricity row)
targets.notes: NDC2 electricity-sector pathway: 'Installation of 2,729.5 MW of renewable energy-based power plants (including hydropower)' by 2030, credited with 11.90 MtCO2e of the 109.87 MtCO2e total reduction. As an LDC, South Sudan's NDC implementation is essentially contingent on international support, so recorded as indicative rather than binding.

targets.scope_note: emission reduction scenario; including hydropower; conditional on finance
targets.instrument_name: South Sudan's Second Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC2, 2021)
targets.source: UNFCCC NDC Registry - South Sudan Second NDC, section 7.5.2 Emission reduction potential
targets.notes: NDC2: 'In the emission reduction scenario, the share of renewable energy will be more than 92 percent including hydropower plants (but 3 percent excluding hydropower) by 2030.' Stated as a floor ('more than'). The ER scenario assumes no new fossil-fuelled plants installed beyond 2021. Baseline scenario by contrast gives a renewable share below 1 percent in 2030.

targets.scope_note: six government-planned hydropower plants; conditional on finance
targets.instrument_name: South Sudan's Second Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC2, 2021)
targets.source: UNFCCC NDC Registry - South Sudan Second NDC, section 7.5.2 emission reduction scenario assumptions
targets.notes: Sum of the six hydropower plants the NDC states will be installed over the next 10 years: Fula (1,800 MW), Shukoli (210 MW), Beden (400 MW), Lakki (210 MW), Sue (12 MW), Kentti (3.5 MW) = 2,635.5 MW. The NDC lists the plants individually; the total is arithmetic from those cited figures, not an independently stated headline number.

targets.scope_note: conditional on USD 500 million of solar investment
targets.instrument_name: South Sudan's Second Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC2, 2021)
targets.source: UNFCCC NDC Registry - South Sudan Second NDC, section 7.5.2 emission reduction scenario assumptions
targets.notes: NDC2: 'Investments of $500 million will be made for solar-based power generation, which translates to 57 MW ... of new solar-powered plants installed by 2030.' Explicitly conditional on the investment materialising; separate from the 20 MW Juba solar plant already assumed in the baseline scenario.

targets.scope_note: conditional on USD 100 million of wind investment
targets.instrument_name: South Sudan's Second Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC2, 2021)
targets.source: UNFCCC NDC Registry - South Sudan Second NDC, section 7.5.2 emission reduction scenario assumptions
targets.notes: NDC2: 'Investments of $100 million will be made for power generation using wind energy, which translates to a total of 11.41 MW ... by 2030.' Conditional on the stated investment.

targets.scope_note: transport sector only; reduction vs baseline
targets.instrument_name: South Sudan's Second Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC2, 2021)
targets.source: UNFCCC NDC Registry - South Sudan Second NDC, sectoral emission reduction pathway table (Transport row)
targets.notes: NDC2 sectoral table: transport pathway is '44% reduction in GHG emissions compared to baseline' by 2030, worth 2.43 MtCO2e. The NDC does not state the baseline year for the transport row explicitly; 2018 is used as the document's general baseline year for the electricity/GHG trajectory, so the baseline_year should be treated as approximate. Conditional on international support.
